name: Music Smartlink Maker
author: Widget

sections.description:
Music Smartlink Maker allows artists, labels, and music marketers to create
simple, fast smartlink landing pages directly inside WordPress.

Each smartlink page can include links to all major music streaming and download
platforms, as well as custom links and artist-related links — all fully managed
manually with complete control.

The plugin does not rely on external APIs or third-party services and does not
send any data externally by default.

Key Features

  • Unlimited smartlink pages
  • Predefined major music streaming and download platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon, Bandcamp, and more)
  • Unlimited custom music links
  • Unlimited artist links (social profiles, websites, press pages)
  • Manual ordering of links
  • Clean, distraction-free frontend landing pages
  • Works entirely within WordPress

PRO Add-on Features

Music Smartlink Maker includes an optional PRO add-on for users who require
advanced campaign tracking and live event management tools.

The PRO add-on extends the free plugin without limiting or disabling any core
functionality.

Unlimited Concerts & Tour Dates

The PRO add-on introduces a dedicated Concerts section inside WordPress, allowing
artists and teams to create and manage unlimited concerts and tour dates.

Each concert supports:
– Event date and time
– Venue name and address
– Ticket purchase link
– Google Maps location functionality

Concerts are automatically organized into upcoming and past events, making it
easy to present future tour dates as well as past performances in a structured
and user-friendly way.

Advanced Meta Pixel Tracking

With the PRO add-on, users can assign a full Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID to individual
smartlink pages.

This enables:
– Campaign optimization for music promotion
– Retargeting audiences based on smartlink engagement
– Conversion tracking across advertising campaigns

Tracking is fully optional and only active when a pixel ID is provided by the
site owner.

Platform-Level Click Tracking

All smartlink interactions are tracked as labeled events, allowing advertisers
to optimize campaigns for each individual music platform.

Each outbound link is identified by its platform name, enabling:
– Per-platform performance analysis
– More precise retargeting audiences
– Improved campaign optimization for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Bandcamp,
and any custom platforms

The PRO add-on does not introduce external services beyond the configured tracking
pixel and respects site owner configuration.

External Services

This plugin may connect to third-party services if you enable specific optional features.

Meta (Facebook) Pixel
– Service: Meta Pixel for conversion tracking and analytics.
– Used for: Tracking page views and link clicks on Smartlink pages for marketing campaign optimization.
– Data sent: IP address, user agent, and event data (PageView, Click) are sent to Meta servers when a Pixel ID is configured by the site admin.
– Condition: Only active if the site administrator explicitly enters a Pixel ID in the Smartlink settings (PRO feature).
– Meta Privacy Policy
– Meta Business Tools Terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Smartlinks → Add New to create your first smartlink page
sections.faq:
Do I need an external account or third-party service to use this plugin?

No. Music Smartlink Maker works entirely inside WordPress and does not require
any external accounts, subscriptions, or API connections.

How many smartlink pages can I create?

You can create unlimited smartlink pages. There are no artificial limits on the
number of pages, links, or artists you can manage.

Which music platforms are supported?

The plugin includes predefined options for major streaming and download platforms
such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon, Bandcamp, and more. In addition,
you can add unlimited custom platforms manually.

Can I add both music links and artist links on the same page?

Yes. Each smartlink page supports both music platform links and artist-related
links such as social profiles, official websites, or press pages.

Is any tracking enabled by default?

No. The free version does not enable any tracking by default. Tracking features
are only available in the optional PRO add-on and are only active when explicitly
configured by the site owner.

What does the PRO add-on include?

The PRO add-on adds optional features such as unlimited concert and tour date
management, advanced Meta Pixel tracking, platform-level click tracking, and
campaign optimization tools. The free plugin remains fully functional on its own.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and does not load unnecessary scripts or external
resources. Smartlink pages are optimized for speed and simplicity.

Is this plugin suitable for labels and marketing teams?

Yes. Music Smartlink Maker is designed to work equally well for independent
artists, labels, managers, and marketing teams who need full control over their
smartlink destinations.
